title: net.ebpf.configure — turns the eBPF probe on or off (docs/plans/network/ebpf.md): TCP health, DNS and run-queue delay per workload. Persisted in /etc/falak/ebpf.json; feature net.ebpf. A kernel that cannot run the probe is a status in the result, not a failed command.

full_dns_names.description: ship whole DNS query names as metric labels (default off: names fold to their registrable domain, api.stripe.com → stripe.com)

reenable.description: clear an over-budget stop (the panel's explicit re-enable only; a re-sent setting never restarts a probe the budget stopped)
